note: Original passages written for the site (CEFR A1 / 國中: present and past simple, going to; American spelling). Each language has its own stories (only the 8 topic tags are shared). Paragraphs and titles are translated into Chinese only (an English one would repeat them). Glossary w = the dictionary form, m = how it appears in the text (underlined there; case-sensitive; list a longer form first). Edit this file, then run: python tools/build_reading.py

s: Last month, a new neighbor moved into the house next to ours.
Her name is Mrs. Green, and she is eighty years old.
paragraphs.zh: 上個月，有一位新鄰居搬進了我們隔壁的房子。她叫格林太太，今年八十歲。

s: Mrs. Green lives alone with her cat.
She has a beautiful garden with lots of flowers.
Every morning, she waters them.
paragraphs.zh: 格林太太一個人和她的貓住。她有一座開滿花的漂亮花園。她每天早上都會澆花。

s: On Saturday, I saw her with three heavy bags from the store.
I helped her carry them into her kitchen.
paragraphs.zh: 星期六，我看到她提著三個從商店買回來的重袋子。我幫她把袋子提進廚房。

s: The next day, she brought us some cookies.
They were delicious!
Now we often talk over the fence.
paragraphs.zh: 隔天，她送了一些餅乾給我們。好好吃！現在我們常常隔著圍籬聊天。

glossary.en: a person who lives next to you
to go to live in a new place
a place with flowers and plants
to hold something and take it somewhere

mcq.q: When did Mrs. Green move in?
mcq.zh: 「Last month, a new neighbor moved into the house」：上個月。
mcq.en: “Last month, a new neighbor moved into the house.”

mcq.q: Who lives with Mrs. Green?
mcq.zh: 「Mrs. Green lives alone with her cat」：她的貓。
mcq.en: “Mrs. Green lives alone with her cat.”

mcq.q: What does she do every morning?
mcq.zh: 「Every morning, she waters them」：澆花。
mcq.en: “Every morning, she waters them” — the flowers.

mcq.q: How did the writer help her?
options: By driving her to the store
mcq.zh: 「I helped her carry them into her kitchen」：幫她提袋子。
mcq.en: “I helped her carry them into her kitchen.”

mcq.q: What did Mrs. Green bring the next day?
mcq.zh: 「she brought us some cookies」：餅乾。

tf.s: Mrs. Green is eighty years old.
tf.zh: ○：「she is eighty years old」。
tf.en: True: she is eighty years old.

tf.s: Her garden has no flowers.
tf.zh: ×：「a beautiful garden with lots of flowers」，有很多花。
tf.en: False: a beautiful garden with lots of flowers.

tf.s: Now they often talk over the fence.
tf.zh: ○：「Now we often talk over the fence」。
tf.en: True: Now we often talk over the fence.

s: Sunday was my dad's birthday.
My sister and I got up early to make him breakfast.
paragraphs.zh: 星期天是爸爸的生日。我和妹妹很早起床幫他做早餐。

s: We decided to make pancakes.
I mixed flour, milk and eggs in a big bowl.
My sister cut some strawberries.
paragraphs.zh: 我們決定做鬆餅。我在一個大碗裡把麵粉、牛奶和雞蛋攪拌在一起。妹妹切了一些草莓。

s: The first pancake was burned, and the kitchen was a mess.
But the other pancakes were perfect.
paragraphs.zh: 第一片鬆餅燒焦了，廚房也亂七八糟。但是其他的鬆餅都很完美。

s: We put them on a plate with the strawberries and a candle.
When Dad saw it, he laughed and gave us a big hug.
paragraphs.zh: 我們把鬆餅、草莓和一根蠟燭放在盤子上。爸爸看到的時候笑了，給了我們一個大大的擁抱。

glossary.en: to put things together and stir
to make into pieces with a knife

mcq.q: Whose birthday was it?
mcq.zh: 「Sunday was my dad's birthday」：爸爸的生日。

mcq.q: What did they make?
mcq.zh: 「We decided to make pancakes」：鬆餅。

mcq.q: What did the sister do?
mcq.zh: 「My sister cut some strawberries」：切草莓。攪拌的是「我」。
mcq.en: “My sister cut some strawberries.” The writer did the mixing.

mcq.q: What was wrong with the first pancake?
mcq.zh: 「The first pancake was burned」：燒焦了。

mcq.q: What did Dad do when he saw it?
mcq.zh: 「he laughed and gave us a big hug」：笑著擁抱他們。
mcq.en: “he laughed and gave us a big hug.”

tf.s: They got up early.
tf.zh: ○：「My sister and I got up early」。
tf.en: True: My sister and I got up early.

tf.s: All the pancakes were burned.
tf.zh: ×：只有第一片燒焦，「the other pancakes were perfect」。
tf.en: False: only the first; the other pancakes were perfect.

tf.s: There was a candle on the plate.
tf.zh: ○：「with the strawberries and a candle」。
tf.en: True: with the strawberries and a candle.

s: Last summer, my family went camping by a lake in the mountains.
We drove there for three hours.
paragraphs.zh: 去年夏天，我們全家去山裡的一座湖邊露營。我們開了三個小時的車。

s: First, my dad and I put up the tent.
It was hard, but we did it in thirty minutes.
Then we went swimming in the lake.
The water was very cold!
paragraphs.zh: 首先，我和爸爸把帳篷搭起來。很難，但是我們三十分鐘就搭好了。然後我們去湖裡游泳。湖水好冰！

s: At night, we made a fire and cooked hot dogs.
There were thousands of stars in the sky.
paragraphs.zh: 晚上我們生了火，煮熱狗。天上有成千上萬顆星星。

s: The only problem was the mosquitoes.
In the morning, my legs were covered in bites.
paragraphs.zh: 唯一的問題是蚊子。早上起來，我的腿上全是蚊子咬的包。

glossary.en: a large area of water with land around it
a shelter you sleep in when camping
flames that give heat and light
something that is difficult or bad

mcq.q: Where did the family go camping?
options: By a lake in the mountains
In a forest near their house
mcq.zh: 「camping by a lake in the mountains」：山裡的湖邊。
mcq.en: “camping by a lake in the mountains.”

mcq.q: How long did they drive?
mcq.zh: 「We drove there for three hours」：三小時。

mcq.q: How long did it take to put up the tent?
mcq.zh: 「we did it in thirty minutes」：三十分鐘。三小時是開車的時間。
mcq.en: “we did it in thirty minutes.” Three hours was the drive.

mcq.q: What did they cook at night?
mcq.zh: 「we made a fire and cooked hot dogs」：熱狗。
mcq.en: “we made a fire and cooked hot dogs.”

mcq.q: What was the only problem?
mcq.zh: 「The only problem was the mosquitoes」：蚊子。

tf.s: The water in the lake was warm.
tf.zh: ×：「The water was very cold!」，很冰。
tf.en: False: The water was very cold!

tf.s: There were many stars in the sky.
tf.zh: ○：「There were thousands of stars in the sky」。
tf.en: True: There were thousands of stars in the sky.

tf.s: The writer put up the tent with Mom.
tf.zh: ×：是「my dad and I」（和爸爸）搭的。
tf.en: False: it was my dad and I.

s: On Saturday morning, the sky was blue and sunny.
My friends and I decided to have a picnic in the park.
paragraphs.zh: 星期六早上，天空很藍，陽光很好。我和朋友們決定去公園野餐。

s: We brought sandwiches, fruit and lemonade.
We sat on a blanket in the sun.
paragraphs.zh: 我們帶了三明治、水果和檸檬汁。我們坐在陽光下的野餐墊上。

s: Suddenly, dark clouds came, and it started to rain.
We ran under a big tree and laughed.
Our sandwiches were wet!
paragraphs.zh: 突然烏雲飄來，開始下雨了。我們跑到一棵大樹下，一邊笑。我們的三明治都濕了！

s: After twenty minutes, the rain stopped.
Then we saw a beautiful rainbow over the park.
paragraphs.zh: 二十分鐘後，雨停了。然後我們看到公園上空出現一道美麗的彩虹。

glossary.en: a white or grey shape in the sky
a curve of colors in the sky

mcq.q: What was the weather like in the morning?
mcq.zh: 「the sky was blue and sunny」：晴朗。

mcq.q: Where did they have the picnic?
mcq.zh: 「a picnic in the park」：公園。

mcq.q: What did they not bring?
mcq.zh: 他們帶了三明治、水果和檸檬汁，沒有蛋糕。
mcq.en: They brought sandwiches, fruit and lemonade — no cake.

mcq.q: Where did they go when it rained?
mcq.zh: 「We ran under a big tree」：大樹下。

mcq.q: What did they see after the rain?
mcq.zh: 「we saw a beautiful rainbow」：彩虹。

tf.s: It rained all day.
tf.zh: ×：「After twenty minutes, the rain stopped」，二十分鐘就停了。
tf.en: False: After twenty minutes, the rain stopped.

tf.s: Their sandwiches got wet.
tf.zh: ○：「Our sandwiches were wet!」。
tf.en: True: Our sandwiches were wet!

tf.s: The rain stopped after twenty minutes.
tf.zh: ○：「After twenty minutes, the rain stopped」。
tf.en: True: After twenty minutes, the rain stopped.

s: On Saturday, our neighbors had a garage sale.
They put old things on tables in front of their house.
paragraphs.zh: 星期六，我們的鄰居辦了一場車庫拍賣（在自家門口賣舊東西）。他們把舊東西放在家門前的桌子上。

s: There were books, toys, clothes and a lamp.
Everything was very cheap.
paragraphs.zh: 有書、玩具、衣服和一盞檯燈。每樣東西都很便宜。

s: I saw an old guitar.
The price was twenty dollars, but I only had fifteen.
The man said, “OK, fifteen is fine.”
paragraphs.zh: 我看到一把舊吉他。價錢是二十元，可是我只有十五元。那位先生說：「好啊，十五元也可以。」

s: I also bought two books for one dollar each.
Now I'm learning to play the guitar every day.
paragraphs.zh: 我還買了兩本書，一本一元。現在我每天都在學彈吉他。

glossary.zh: 車庫拍賣（在家門口賣舊物）
glossary.en: a sale of old things at someone's home
to get to know how to do something

mcq.q: Who had the garage sale?
mcq.zh: 「our neighbors had a garage sale」：鄰居。

mcq.q: Where were the old things?
options: On tables in front of the house
mcq.zh: 「on tables in front of their house」：家門前的桌子上。
mcq.en: “on tables in front of their house.”

mcq.q: What was the price of the guitar?
mcq.zh: 「The price was twenty dollars」：標價二十元。十五元是最後付的錢。
mcq.en: “The price was twenty dollars.” Fifteen is what he paid.

mcq.q: How much did the writer pay for the guitar?
mcq.zh: 「OK, fifteen is fine」：十五元。

mcq.q: What else did the writer buy?
mcq.zh: 「I also bought two books」：兩本書。

tf.s: Everything was very expensive.
tf.zh: ×：「Everything was very cheap」。
tf.en: False: Everything was very cheap.

tf.s: Each book cost one dollar.
tf.zh: ○：「two books for one dollar each」。
tf.en: True: two books for one dollar each.

tf.s: The writer is learning the guitar.
tf.zh: ○：「Now I'm learning to play the guitar every day」。
tf.en: True: Now I'm learning to play the guitar every day.

s: This month, our science teacher gave us a project.
We had to make something and explain it to the class.
paragraphs.zh: 這個月，自然老師給了我們一份作業。我們要做出一樣東西，並向全班說明。

s: My partner Kevin and I made a volcano.
We used paper, glue and paint.
paragraphs.zh: 我和搭檔凱文做了一座火山。我們用了紙、膠水和顏料。

s: Inside the volcano, we put baking soda.
When we added vinegar, red foam came out of the top!
Everyone in the class shouted, “Wow!”
paragraphs.zh: 我們在火山裡面放了小蘇打。加入醋的時候，紅色的泡沫從山頂冒了出來！全班都大叫：「哇！」

s: We got second place.
Our teacher said it was very creative.
paragraphs.zh: 我們得了第二名。老師說我們的作品很有創意。

glossary.en: a piece of planned school work

mcq.q: Who gave them the project?
mcq.zh: 「our science teacher gave us a project」：自然老師。
mcq.en: “our science teacher gave us a project.”

mcq.q: What did they make?
mcq.zh: 「Kevin and I made a volcano」：火山。

mcq.q: What came out of the top?
mcq.zh: 「red foam came out of the top」：紅色泡沫。
mcq.en: “red foam came out of the top.”

mcq.q: What place did they get?
mcq.zh: 「We got second place」：第二名。

mcq.q: What did the teacher say?
mcq.zh: 「Our teacher said it was very creative」：很有創意。
mcq.en: “Our teacher said it was very creative.”

tf.s: They used paper, glue and paint.
tf.zh: ○：「We used paper, glue and paint」。
tf.en: True: We used paper, glue and paint.

tf.s: They put vinegar inside the volcano first.
tf.zh: ×：先放的是「baking soda」（小蘇打），之後才加醋。
tf.en: False: baking soda went in first; the vinegar was added after.

tf.s: Nobody in the class was surprised.
tf.zh: ×：「Everyone in the class shouted, “Wow!”」。
tf.en: False: Everyone in the class shouted, “Wow!”

s: Last winter, I flew to Seoul to visit my uncle.
It was my first time on a plane.
paragraphs.zh: 去年冬天，我搭飛機去首爾看叔叔。那是我第一次坐飛機。

s: At the airport, I was a little nervous.
But the flight attendant was very kind and showed me my seat.
I had a window seat!
paragraphs.zh: 在機場的時候我有點緊張。但是空服員很親切，帶我找到座位。我坐靠窗的位子！

s: When the plane took off, my ears hurt a little.
Then I looked out of the window.
We were above the clouds, and they looked like cotton.
paragraphs.zh: 飛機起飛的時候，我的耳朵有點痛。然後我看向窗外。我們在雲的上面，雲看起來像棉花一樣。

s: The flight took three hours.
My uncle was waiting for me at the airport with a big sign.
paragraphs.zh: 飛行花了三個小時。叔叔拿著一個大牌子在機場等我。

glossary.en: a place where planes land and take off
a board with words on it

mcq.q: Where did the writer fly to?
mcq.zh: 「I flew to Seoul」：首爾。

mcq.q: Who did the writer visit?
mcq.zh: 「to visit my uncle」：叔叔。

mcq.q: What kind of seat did the writer have?
mcq.zh: 「I had a window seat!」：靠窗的位子。

mcq.q: What happened when the plane took off?
options: The writer's ears hurt a little
mcq.zh: 「my ears hurt a little」：耳朵有點痛。

mcq.q: How long was the flight?
mcq.zh: 「The flight took three hours」：三小時。

tf.s: The writer was on a plane for the first time.
tf.zh: ○：「It was my first time on a plane」。
tf.en: True: It was my first time on a plane.

tf.s: The clouds looked like cotton.
tf.zh: ○：「they looked like cotton」。
tf.en: True: they looked like cotton.

tf.s: Nobody was waiting at the airport.
tf.zh: ×：「My uncle was waiting for me at the airport」。
tf.en: False: My uncle was waiting for me at the airport.

s: Yesterday was very hot.
After lunch, I ate three ice creams with my friends.
paragraphs.zh: 昨天很熱。午餐後，我和朋友們吃了三支冰淇淋。

s: During math class, my stomach started to hurt.
I told my teacher, and she sent me to the school nurse.
paragraphs.zh: 上數學課的時候，我的肚子開始痛。我告訴老師，她叫我去找學校護士。

s: The nurse asked me, “What did you eat today?”
When I told her, she smiled and said, “That's too much ice cream!”
paragraphs.zh: 護士問我：「你今天吃了什麼？」我告訴她以後，她笑著說：「冰淇淋吃太多了！」

s: She gave me a glass of warm water and let me rest for an hour.
Next time, I'll only eat one ice cream.
paragraphs.zh: 她給我一杯溫水，讓我休息了一個小時。下次我只吃一支冰淇淋就好。

glossary.en: the part of your body where food goes
to tell someone to go somewhere
a person who looks after sick people

mcq.q: How many ice creams did the writer eat?
mcq.zh: 「I ate three ice creams」：三支。

mcq.q: When did the writer's stomach start to hurt?
mcq.zh: 「During math class, my stomach started to hurt」：數學課。
mcq.en: “During math class, my stomach started to hurt.”

mcq.q: Who did the teacher send the writer to?
mcq.zh: 「she sent me to the school nurse」：學校護士。
mcq.en: “she sent me to the school nurse.”

mcq.q: What did the nurse give the writer?
mcq.zh: 「She gave me a glass of warm water」：一杯溫水。
mcq.en: “She gave me a glass of warm water.”

mcq.q: How long did the writer rest?
mcq.zh: 「let me rest for an hour」：一小時。

tf.s: It was cold yesterday.
tf.zh: ×：「Yesterday was very hot」。
tf.en: False: Yesterday was very hot.

tf.s: The nurse smiled.
tf.zh: ○：「she smiled and said…」。
tf.en: True: she smiled and said…

tf.s: Next time, the writer will eat only one ice cream.
tf.zh: ○：「Next time, I'll only eat one ice cream」。
tf.en: True: Next time, I'll only eat one ice cream.

items.text:
A  Maria
I live in a flat in the city centre with my mum and my brother. I walk to school. After school I play the piano. I love music!

B  Ben
I live on a farm with my family. We have cows, sheep and three dogs. I go to school by bus. At the weekend I help my dad.

C  Lily
I live in a small house near the sea. I have a sister and a cat. I go to school by bike. I swim in the sea in the summer.

tr.zh:
A 瑪麗亞：我和媽媽、哥哥住在市中心的公寓。我走路上學。放學後我彈鋼琴。我愛音樂！
B 班：我和家人住在農場。我們有牛、羊和三隻狗。我搭公車上學。週末我幫爸爸。
C 莉莉：我住在海邊的小房子。我有一個姐姐和一隻貓。我騎腳踏車上學。夏天我在海裡游泳。

questions.q: Who has a lot of animals?
questions.zh: 班的農場有牛、羊和三隻狗。

questions.q: Who goes to school on foot?

items.text:
My Grandma
My grandma's name is Rose. She is seventy years old and she lives in a small village. Every Sunday my family visits her. She makes a big lunch for us — chicken, potatoes and a chocolate cake. After lunch we walk in the park near her house. Grandma has a garden with lots of flowers. Her favourite flowers are yellow. She also has an old dog called Max. Next month it is Grandma's birthday. We are going to give her a new hat.

tr.zh:
我的奶奶
我奶奶叫蘿絲，七十歲，住在一個小村子。每個星期天我們全家都去看她。她會為我們做一頓豐盛的午餐：雞肉、馬鈴薯和巧克力蛋糕。午餐後我們在她家附近的公園散步。奶奶有一個種了很多花的花園，她最喜歡黃色的花。她還有一隻老狗叫麥克斯。下個月是奶奶的生日，我們要送她一頂新帽子。

questions.q: When does the family visit Grandma?
What do they eat for lunch?
What do they do after lunch?
What colour are Grandma's favourite flowers?
What are they going to give Grandma?

I'm (17) ＿＿＿＿＿ holiday in London with my parents. We are staying (18) ＿＿＿＿＿ a hotel near the river. Yesterday we went to a big museum. It (19) ＿＿＿＿＿ very interesting. Today we are going to (20) ＿＿＿＿＿ a boat trip. I (21) ＿＿＿＿＿ you are well!

親愛的安娜：
我和爸媽在倫敦度假。我們住在河邊的一家旅館。昨天我們去了一間很大的博物館，很有趣。今天我們要去坐船遊覽。希望你一切都好！
愛你的艾瑪

items.text:
A Day at the Beach
Last Saturday was hot and sunny, so my friend Ella and I went to the beach. We went by train. It took one hour. At the beach we swam in the sea and played volleyball. For lunch we had sandwiches and apples. Then Ella bought two ice creams. In the afternoon it was windy, so we went to a small café and had hot chocolate. We got home at six o'clock. We were tired but very happy.

tr.zh:
海邊的一天
上星期六又熱又晴朗，所以我和朋友艾拉去了海邊。我們搭火車去，花了一個小時。在海邊我們在海裡游泳、打排球。午餐吃三明治和蘋果。然後艾拉買了兩支冰淇淋。下午起風了，所以我們去了一家小咖啡館喝熱巧克力。我們六點到家，很累但很開心。

questions.q: How did they go to the beach?

My favourite food is pasta. I cook it with my dad every Friday. I don't like fish. I drink a lot of water.

B  Leo
I love fruit! I eat bananas and apples every day. I don't like cooking, but my mum makes great soup. I drink milk.

C  Ruby
I eat fish every week because I live near the sea. I like making cakes with my grandma. My favourite drink is orange juice.

tr.zh:
A 妮娜：我最喜歡的食物是義大利麵。我每個星期五和爸爸一起煮。我不喜歡魚。我喝很多水。
B 里歐：我愛水果！我每天吃香蕉和蘋果。我不喜歡做菜，但我媽媽煮的湯很棒。我喝牛奶。
C 露比：我每週都吃魚，因為我住在海邊。我喜歡和奶奶一起做蛋糕。我最喜歡的飲料是柳橙汁。

items.text:
My New School
I started at a new school in September. It is big — there are eight hundred students! My class has twenty-five students and our teacher is Mr Green. He is very funny and he teaches us history. My new friend is called Ali. He sits next to me. We have lunch together every day in the school café. After school on Wednesdays I go to the art club. I like my new school, but the school day is long. It finishes at four o'clock.

tr.zh:
我的新學校
我九月開始上新學校。學校很大，有八百個學生！我們班有二十五個學生，老師是格林老師。他很有趣，教我們歷史。我的新朋友叫阿里，他坐在我旁邊。我們每天一起在學校餐廳吃午餐。每星期三放學後我去美術社。我喜歡新學校，但上學時間很長，四點才放學。

questions.q: How many students are in the writer's class?
What does the writer do on Wednesdays?

B 米亞：我住在山邊的小村子，和朋友走路上學。我喜歡美術，每個週末都畫畫。
C 莎拉：我住在海邊的公寓，媽媽開車送我上學。我喜歡自然科學，星期六和爸爸去駕帆船。

items.text:
My grandma
My grandma is seventy years old, but she is very busy. She lives in a small house with a big garden. Every morning she works in the garden for two hours. She grows potatoes, carrots and beautiful flowers. In the afternoon she reads books or visits her friends.
Every Sunday my family goes to her house for lunch. She always cooks chicken with vegetables from her garden. After lunch, my brother and I help her in the garden, and then we all have tea and cake. I love Sundays with my grandma! — Jack

tr.zh:
我的奶奶
我奶奶七十歲了，但她很忙。她住在有大花園的小房子裡。每天早上她在花園工作兩個小時，種馬鈴薯、紅蘿蔔和漂亮的花。下午她看書或去拜訪朋友。
每個星期天我們全家去她家吃午餐。她總是用花園裡的蔬菜煮雞肉。午餐後我和哥哥幫她整理花園，然後大家一起喝茶吃蛋糕。我愛和奶奶一起過星期天！——傑克

questions.q: What does Grandma do every morning?
